events.title: Target boosts 2026 outlook after Q2 sales and earnings beat
events.summary: Target (NYSE:TGT) has increased its full-year 2026 outlook following better-than-expected second-quarter results, with sales up 5.3% to $26.54 billion and adjusted EPS of $4.11, exceeding analyst estimates. The company saw strong growth across all merchandise categories, driven by digital sales and same-day delivery, and has raised its net sales growth and operating income margin rate projections for the full year. Target also increased its full-year GAAP and adjusted EPS guidance, largely due to tariff refund benefits.

articles.headline: Target boosts 2026 outlook after Q2 sales and earnings beat

events.title: Massachusetts governor warn NextEra-Dominion merger could hike energy costs
events.summary: Massachusetts Governor Maura Healey and Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell are opposing the proposed merger between NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy, citing concerns about potential increases in electricity costs, reduced market competition, and risks to grid reliability. Five New England states, excluding New Hampshire, have urged federal regulators to scrutinize the deal, which would consolidate ownership of the region's two remaining nuclear power plants. State officials highlighted NextEra's past actions, including efforts to block a transmission line and attempts to pass costs to ratepayers, as reasons for their opposition.

articles.headline: Massachusetts governor warn NextEra-Dominion merger could hike energy costs

events.title: Analog Devices Q3 2026 earnings beat on AI data center demand
events.summary: Analog Devices reported record fiscal third-quarter revenue of $4.02 billion, a 40% year-over-year increase, surpassing analyst expectations due to strong demand for data center and industrial chips, particularly driven by AI infrastructure. The company also provided a record outlook for Q4 and announced the acquisition of Empower Semiconductor for $1.5 billion to enhance its position in AI power delivery.

articles.headline: Analog Devices Q3 2026 earnings beat on AI data center demand

events.title: Resilient Waste Management stock holds after Q2 earnings beat as sustainability theme supports valua
events.summary: Waste Management (WM) stock is trading around $224 in mid-August 2026, supported by a strong Q2 2026 earnings beat and steady revenue growth. The company reported EPS of $2.02, exceeding analyst estimates, and demonstrated robust profitability metrics including an 11.11% net margin and 31.68% return on equity. Analysts maintain a positive outlook, with an average price target suggesting over 15% upside, driven by the company's strong core operations and expanding sustainability initiatives.

articles.headline: Resilient Waste Management stock holds after Q2 earnings beat as sustainability theme supports valua

events.title: Target (NYSE: TGT) nearly doubles Q2 EPS as tariff refunds hit
events.summary: Target (NYSE: TGT) reported robust Q2 2026 results, with net sales growing 5.3% to $26.5 billion and EPS doubling to $4.11, significantly boosted by $994 million in pretax tariff refunds. Excluding these refunds, EPS still increased by 20%. The company also raised its full-year 2026 guidance, expecting net sales growth of around 5% and GAAP and Adjusted EPS of $9.90–$10.90, including the tariff benefit.

articles.headline: Target (NYSE: TGT) nearly doubles Q2 EPS as tariff refunds hit

events.summary: Teledyne Technologies stock is trading near $666.39 following its $1.1 billion all-cash acquisition of Varex Imaging. events.title: Oxbow Advisors LLC Acquires Shares of 19,733 Ventas, Inc. $VTR
events.summary: Oxbow Advisors LLC has acquired 19,733 shares of Ventas, Inc. (NYSE:VTR) in the second quarter, valued at approximately $1.75 million. events.title: Gov. Mills calls the proposed NextEra, Dominion merger a ‘bad deal for Maine’
events.summary: Governor Janet Mills has publicly opposed the proposed merger between NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy, labeling it a "bad deal for Maine." She argues that the merger would consolidate too many energy assets under one company, thereby limiting competition and potentially leading to higher electricity costs for Maine residents. U.S. Senator Angus King also recommends rejecting the merger, citing NextEra's past anti-competitive behavior in New England.

articles.headline: Gov. Mills calls the proposed NextEra, Dominion merger a ‘bad deal for Maine’

events.title: Fortinet eyes AI security gains with Virtue AI acquisition
events.summary: Fortinet has acquired Virtue AI, an AI security specialist, to enhance its existing Security for AI portfolio with AI runtime protection and automated validation capabilities. This acquisition aims to strengthen Fortinet's ability to protect AI models and applications across their lifecycle, addressing the expanding attack surface as organizations increasingly deploy AI. The deal comes as the market for securing AI ecosystems is projected to grow significantly, with financial terms remaining undisclosed but deemed "immaterial" to Fortinet's business.

articles.headline: Fortinet eyes AI security gains with Virtue AI acquisition

events.title: Profusa (PFSA) Slides 18% As Acquisition Plan Rattles Traders
events.summary: Profusa Inc. (PFSA) shares dropped 18% after the company announced a non-binding term sheet to acquire a privately held diagnostics and toxicology testing business. This move has raised concerns among traders about potential dilution or new debt due to PFSA's weak balance sheet. Despite the sell-off, the stock remains a high-volatility trading vehicle, attracting momentum traders.

articles.headline: Profusa (PFSA) Slides 18% As Acquisition Plan Rattles Traders

events.title: FedEx-led consortium clears major hurdle in $9B acquisition
events.summary: A FedEx-led consortium has received EU approval for its acquisition of InPost, a deal valued at $9 billion. FedEx is expected to hold a 37% stake in InPost if the proposal is finalized. The article also mentions the Memphis Business Journal's "Building Memphis Awards 2027" nominations.

articles.headline: FedEx-led consortium clears major hurdle in $9B acquisition

events.title: Targa Resources inks ExxonMobil deals, plans new Permian Basin projects
events.summary: Targa Resources Corp. is increasing its capital expenditures for 2026 due to new Permian Basin projects and agreements with ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. The Houston-based company has been growing organically and through acquisitions, and these new deals will further boost its spending next year.

articles.headline: Targa Resources inks ExxonMobil deals, plans new Permian Basin projects

events.title: Mizuho Markets Head Expects BOJ to Raise Rates Soon, More Often
events.summary: Mizuho Financial Group Inc. anticipates the Bank of Japan will accelerate its interest rate hikes, with the next increase potentially occurring as early as next month. This expectation is driven by a weak yen and persistent inflation, pushing the central bank to act more decisively. Additionally, Mizuho's co-head of global markets, Kenya Koshimizu, foresees continued rises in longer-term rates, following 10-year Japanese government bond yields reaching a 30-year high.

articles.headline: Mizuho Markets Head Expects BOJ to Raise Rates Soon, More Often

events.title: Jack Henry shares jump over 3% on earnings beat and strong guidance
events.summary: Jack Henry & Associates Inc. (NASDAQ:JKHY) reported strong fourth-quarter results, surpassing analyst expectations for both adjusted EPS and revenue. The financial technology provider also issued robust fiscal year 2027 guidance that exceeded consensus estimates, leading to a 3.8% surge in its share price. The company highlighted record sales, financial results for fiscal 2026, and a significant number of competitive core wins.

articles.headline: Jack Henry shares jump over 3% on earnings beat and strong guidance

events.title: ONEOK stock hits fresh 52-week high as analysts lift targets
events.summary: ONEOK Inc. (OKE) stock reached a new 52-week high on August 18, 2026, trading in the mid-$90s, driven by positive analyst sentiment and consistent demand for its midstream energy assets. The stock has seen a 29.7% year-to-date increase, and while the average analyst price target is around $91.94, some targets have been raised to $105.00, maintaining a consensus "Moderate Buy" rating. The company's strong performance is attributed to its stable, fee-based cash flows from natural gas and natural gas liquids infrastructure, making it an attractive income and infrastructure holding.

articles.headline: ONEOK stock hits fresh 52-week high as analysts lift targets

events.title: NRG Energy Slides 5.2% as Texas Pricing Weighs; Analysts See 68.6% Upside
events.summary: NRG Energy's stock fell 5.2% to $115.96 due to concerns about Texas electricity pricing, mild weather, and increased supply costs, which led to a 25.6% decline in Texas adjusted EBITDA. Despite this, eleven analysts maintain an average price target of $195.55, suggesting a 68.6% upside, highlighting a significant gap between market performance and analyst expectations. The company is pursuing strategies like customer-backed agreements for data center facilities to mitigate risks and capitalize on flexible assets.

articles.headline: NRG Energy Slides 5.2% as Texas Pricing Weighs; Analysts See 68.6% Upside

events.title: MGM Resorts stock holds steady after Q2 2026 earnings beat
events.summary: MGM Resorts International's stock is holding steady in the low-$40s range after the company reported Q2 2026 results that surpassed revenue and EPS expectations. The company highlighted strong demand from its Las Vegas properties and its philanthropic efforts. Despite the earnings beat, the stock experienced a modest post-earnings pullback, suggesting investors may be evaluating medium-term growth prospects.

articles.headline: MGM Resorts stock holds steady after Q2 2026 earnings beat

events.title: Bank of America Says $5,000 Gold Is Within Reach
events.summary: Bank of America projects that gold could reach $5,000 an ounce, despite its current trading price of around $4,358. This optimistic outlook is fueled by softer U.S. economic data, a weaker dollar, and anticipated reduced tightening by the Federal Reserve, alongside strong central bank demand. The next challenge for gold's upward trajectory will be sustained investor interest through dropping rates and increased ETF demand.

articles.headline: Bank of America Says $5,000 Gold Is Within Reach
